## Delivered

- **`dot_511` `arcgis_s1` target kind (P37.53)** — the screened programme-level lane over the merged camera-registry target registry. Two closed modes, both fail-closed at registration (`assert_target_s1` → `S1SpecNotDeclared`):
  - `operator_screen` — the server-side `s1_operator_field IN (s1_agency_values…)` screen fetches the reviewed agency-operated rows only (OBJECTID + geometry, the P8-5 minimal allowlist), and ONE `returnCountOnly=true` page over the complement collapses every other row to a published `programme_count` on a `programme_area:` subject. Private-operator values are never declared, fetched or captured; a screen miss lands rows in the count, never a fabricated device.
  - `count_only` — registrant-class layers whole: ONE `returnCountOnly` page; the published total IS the `programme_count` claim. No row bytes, coordinates or registrant fields ever cross.
  - Count envelopes parse only an integer non-negative `count`; `features` members, error envelopes, non-JSON, non-object, missing/negative counts → `ContentDrift`. Exact-URL page matching runs before layer-prefix matching so a count page can never resolve as a feature page. `s1_*` fields are rejected on non-`arcgis_s1` kinds; `s1_operator_field` joins the Part VIII denylist scan (`arcgis_s1` joins `DENYLIST_KINDS`). S1 rows never mint camera/device subjects, geometry, registrant or operator claims; technology + jurisdiction come from the target declarations.
- **`django_rest_api` connector (new)** — the bounded DRF envelope lane for `camreg_la_new_orleans_eye_on` (Eye on Surveillance New Orleans): `{"count": <int>, "results": [...]}` fetched with `page_size=1` so at most one result row crosses; the published count + result field names are retained — result-row values never are. Denied field names, >1 result rows, error envelopes, non-JSON/non-object payloads, non-integer count, missing `results` → fail closed.
